nodes.label: ibis API
nodes.desc: Entry points such as ibis.table, ibis.memtable and the deferred placeholder build expressions.

nodes.label: Table expr
nodes.desc: Lazy Table expression exposing filter, aggregate, join and export methods.

nodes.label: ops Node
nodes.desc: Immutable base class of the operations intermediate representation.

nodes.label: Relation ops
nodes.desc: Project, Filter, Aggregate and JoinChain ops model the relational algebra.

nodes.label: Rewrites
nodes.desc: simplify() canonicalizes filter and project ordering before compilation.

nodes.label: BaseBackend
nodes.desc: Engine-agnostic interface with table, compile and execute methods.

nodes.label: SQLGlotCompiler
nodes.desc: Shared sqlglot-based compiler that lowers operations into SQL ASTs.

nodes.label: DuckDBCompiler
nodes.desc: DuckDB dialect specialization of the shared SQL compiler.

nodes.label: Polars translate
nodes.desc: singledispatch translator that lowers operations to native polars expressions.

nodes.label: DuckDB engine
nodes.desc: In-process analytics engine that executes the generated SQL.

nodes.label: Polars engine
nodes.desc: LazyFrame engine that executes native polars plans.

nodes.label: PyArrowData
nodes.desc: Maps results into Arrow so to_pandas, to_pyarrow and to_polars share one path.
